title: COPY handler returns WC_HW_E for active state, CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for idle
description: What is correct and why: The WC_COPY handler (port.c:1532-1595) checks devCtx before deciding its return code. If devCtx \!= NULL (op_fd is open, data has been fed to hardware), it returns WC_HW_E. If devCtx == NULL (no active hardware state), it returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (safe to copy). A future contributor might 'simplify' this to always return WC_HW_E (breaking lazy-copy of idle sha objects in TLS) or always return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE (causing use-after-free when both the original and the copy try to Finalize the same op_fd and free the same ctx pointer, then double-close the fd — which the OS may have reused). The distinction is correct and load-bearing.
